text:
Marathon Petroleum has climbed 7.81% over two weeks and added another 0.31% today, riding a sharp rally since late August. The driver is clear: global refinery disruptions are tightening diesel and fuel supplies. Ukraine's strikes on Russian refineries and escalating Iran sanctions (which the EU formally joined today) are knocking out refining capacity worldwide, while U.S. refineries are already running flat-out at 98% capacity. This forces up the value of fuel that American refineries can produce, which directly benefits a major refiner's margins.

Diesel prices have hit records as a result, and with oil storage steady around 711 million barrels and gasoline stockpiles moderate, there's little buffer to absorb supply shocks. The geopolitical backdrop—Iran missile strikes, potential Strait of Hormuz disruptions, and export bans from Russia—keeps the market tight and supports refiner profits.
